title: Repair the hollow Melody Maker entity-count test without claiming a reduction
intent: F-2 read a missing attribute through getattr default 0, so the reduction assertion could not fail. Read dxf.entity_count directly, check it once against the emitted DXF, and stop asserting a reduction until F-3 reports that masking was applied.
behavior_change: Test integrity only. No vectorizer algorithm, orchestrator, result model, DXF generation, OCR capability, workflow, or default API CI change. The real-plan tests remain on the vectorizer_regression marker.

diff_articulation.what_changed: test_entity_count_reduction is now test_melody_maker_reports_entity_counts. It reads result.dxf.entity_count and checks one emitted DXF. It does not assert masked < unmasked. Fast tests cover a missing count, an artifact mismatch, an applied reduction, an identical applied pair, and a refused comparison when applied is not true. The Melody Maker fixture uses the same two-call cache. The 2026-10-03 census is unchanged; the evidence test maps the old test id to the new name. The dogfood evidence test accepts a stored copy of the scanned regression bytes when the live file no longer matches that pin.
diff_articulation.why: The previous assertion compared zeros and could not detect a failed mask. Claiming a reduction now would also be false, because the result does not yet report whether masking was applied.
diff_articulation.why_not_redundant: CODE-TOOL-DOGFOOD-003 classified the detector miss and left the test hollow. This order repairs the test. It does not add a detector and it does not repair F-3.
diff_articulation.what_did_not_change: edge_to_dxf.py, the orchestrator, result models, DXF generation, OCR installation, vectorizer-regression.yml, core CI marker exclusion, DETECTOR_RUNS.json hashes, defects_repaired, the dogfood sentence that neither defect was repaired, and the 2026-10-03 census.

commands_run: gh pr merge 434 --merge  # merged as fbf36095b99d0a97ee4574f27d6482a09e87bd6c; branch cut from that main
python3 scripts/ci/check_cbsp21_gate.py --changed-files <manifest, closeout, regression test, helper, fast tests, census evidence test>  # PASSED, coverage 100%
git diff --name-only  # no services/api/app, photo-vectorizer, edge_to_dxf, workflow, or pytest.ini path
proofs: 30 tests passed: the dogfood source-blob check accepts the stored scan (content sha256 6f256e19226f8b06f75e882dfc382decd1e9135051d6306d53aee9b8289dfd03, git blob 0bbc72d56eac600a695105976578cb46930b5c1f); missing dxf and entity_count raise; a mismatched artifact fails; applied equal counts fail; applied is required before a strict reduction comparison.
The census evidence test still matches the 2026-10-03 excluded set through the rename map. The census file was not edited.
The Melody Maker PDF was not converted in this run. The two-call cache is the function the fixture uses, and the fast test calls it four times and records two computes.
verification.hardware: No machine execution and no manufacturing output.
